thesis: AMPH is a profitable, cheap, accelerating-growth name in a confirmed uptrend, pulling back to SMA20 and the range floor, which gives a low-chase entry with a defined stop and a clear 52-week-high target. Revenue growth has gone from flat to +8.2% YoY over three quarters and Q3 net income rose sharply, while forward P/E is single digit. Defensive-leaning healthcare is one of the few areas holding up in a risk-off tape, and 21.7% short interest adds squeeze fuel. The setup is only moderate: the regime is hostile, the stop is tight, and the price is above the consensus target, so this is a small-conviction long at best.
